description: Kryptos K4 exploratory unknown-cipher record. Its full plaintext was privately recovered and artist-confirmed in 2025, but neither that plaintext nor a reproducible key/method is public benchmark ground truth.
agentic_hypothesis: Use unknown-cipher diagnostics and explicit hypothesis tracking to characterize K4, test supported families, and check candidates against only the public crib constraints allowed by the selected context tier. Do not treat family coverage or crib agreement as a solved plaintext.
baseline_expected_failure_mode: Supported searches may produce plausible candidates or eliminate families, but no current Decipher capability demonstrates recovery of K4 and no full automated accuracy score is valid.
